name: Semaphore
description: Semaphore's hosted server reads pipelines, workflows and job logs so the agent can explain a red build.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.semaphoreci.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
